newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius investment firm GIDC posts loss in 95/96.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius investment firm GIDC posts loss in 95/96.

text.p: Mauritian investment firm General Investment and Development Company (GIDC) on Tuesday posted a loss before tax of 20.1 million rupees ($976,000) for the year ending 30 June 1996 against a profit of 11.9 million rupees before tax the previous financial year.
In 1995/96, GIDC's turnover was up to 254.6 million rupees from 230.0 million rupees in 1994/95, company officials said.
They said GIDC posted a loss after tax of 23.3 million rupees in 1995/96 from a 11.9 million rupees profit after tax in 1994/95.
"Group results for the year show a loss....largely attributable to the poor performance of certain of the group's commercial subsidiaries and associated companies," a GIDC company statement said.
"All appropriate measures have been taken to restructure all aspects of the companies concerned. Trading conditions, however, remain difficult," the statement added.
